steps.name: Build and push Docker image
steps.run: export IMAGE_NAME=$(echo $FORGE_REPO_NAME | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') && echo "{\"auths\":{\"$REGISTRY\":{\"auth\":\"$(echo -n $GITHUB_ACTOR:$GITHUB_TOKEN | base64 | tr -d '\n')\"}}}" > /kaniko/.docker/config.json && /kaniko/executor --context dir:///workspace --dockerfile ./Dockerfile --destination $REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:$FORGE_COMMIT_SHA --destination $REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:latest
